title: Night Departure
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A cinematic night-flight through atmospheric drum and bass: vast supersaw pads with slow attack and heavy reverb carry the melody upward while chopped amen breaks and a deep rolling sub anchor the groove. After the first peak an atmospheric valley dissolves into filtered space before a second build re-enters with shifting pads and a longer, harder second peak — runway lights rushing below, then fading into the distance.
